sourceBrief: A real cinematic voyage begins as a folded paper boat. AutoPromote generates the raw material from an idea and uses its existing Director and render pipeline to make the film. The reveal is a full-size working boat at sea, not a paper boat surviving at sea.

images.prompt: Cinematic photograph of one full-size classic mahogany sailing yacht crossing deep blue ocean waves. Cream triangular canvas sails, real rigging, polished timber hull, brass rails, powerful white bow wake. Entire yacht visible, low water-level tracking angle, storm clouds opening to warm amber sunlight, photoreal marine cinematography.
images.negative_prompt: paper boat, origami, miniature, toy, model, extra boats, impossible rigging, warped hull, bird, crane, text, logo, watermark, cartoon, plastic
